name: codex-orchestration
description: Parent-routed single-agent execution with previous-task continuity.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 9.0.1 routes read-only work and small tweaks to Luna / Medium; standard artifacts to Terra / Medium; design artifacts and small builds to Terra / Max; big tweaks to Terra / High; and big builds to Sol / High. The parent classifies internally and immediately launches one implementer in its first response, eliminating the separate classifier spawn and wait. The selected implementer receives the complete task context, performs the work, verifies it, completes any explicitly authorized release, and writes the final response.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
